units.source_text: 这汉子背着一个大柳条包。

en.t: This man was carrying a large wicker trunk on his back.

units.source_text: 那位四十岁的女人抱着一条小狗。

en.t: The forty-year-old woman was holding a small dog in her arms.

units.source_text: 年纪最大的姑娘挎着包袱。

en.t: The oldest girl had a bundle tucked under her arm.

units.source_text: 另一个姑娘拎着柳条包。

en.t: Another girl was carrying a wicker trunk by hand.
Each of them was carrying some large piece of luggage.
The dancer, however, was carrying a drum and its stand on her back.

units.source_text: 四十岁的女人慢慢地也同我搭起话来。

en.t: The forty-year-old woman gradually began talking with me as well.
